definitions: An official directive issued by authorities during an emergency, such as a hazardous material spill or an active shooter event, instructing people to remain indoors and take protective measures rather than evacuating.
A public health directive issued during an pandemic or other widespread health crisis, instructing people to stay at home and limit non-essential activities to prevent the spread of disease.
examples: The city issued a shelter-in-place order due to the chemical leak.
Residents were advised to follow the shelter-in-place order.
A shelter-in-place order was enacted to curb the virus's spread.
